_about: SHELF of Spanish, Spanish-American and Brazilian classics in English before 1931: Underhill's four series of Benavente's Plays (1917-1924), the Martínez Sierra plays in Underhill's and the Granville-Barkers' versions (1922), Rollo Ogden's Isaacs María (1890), Mrs. Horace Mann's Sarmiento Facundo (1868), Isabel Burton's Alencar Iraçéma (1886) and Walsh and de la Selva's Darío (1916). Mary J. Serrano's Valera and Mármol are on the serrano shelf. Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 93); Adam may veto. No uids minted. Round 111 (2026-10-17, vetoable) added Langton's Espinel (1816), Saldkeld's Gracián (1730), Jacobs's Gracián (1892, 1904 printing) and North's Guevara (1568). Round 119 added Churton's Góngora (1862, 2 vols) and Lorente's Graça Aranha, Canaan (1920). Round 124 (2026-10-23, vetoable) added Alarcón's The Three-Cornered Hat (Fassett, Knopf 1918) and Júlio Dinis's The Fidalgos of Casa Mourisca (Roxana L. Dabney, Lothrop 1891).
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check. Common surnames (walsh, mann, ogden, burton) are never listed bare.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.

_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). Any post-1930 year there was examined by eye; see the title's scan_edition.
